description:
HONOR SEASON EDITION - 17ART
The Only Capybara To Ever Win A Freedom Of Speech Case While Blazed
They tried to cancel the legend in court. They sued. They subpoenaed. They rolled up with their serious government faces ready to muzzle the funk.
Too bad they weren’t ready for CHIGUIAFROMAN — the jet-black, Afro’d-out capybara king, full patriotic suit dripping stars & stripes, one paw casually on the witness stand like he’s ordering another round at the bar.
Why a capybara? Simple, degenerates: capybaras are nature’s ultimate troll. The most unbothered creature on planet Earth. Ducks use them as floating jungle gyms. Crocodiles chill next to them like roommates. Government tries to stomp your 1st Amendment rights? This king just leans back, remembers the hook to “Because I Got High,” and still bodies the entire system. Zero stress. Maximum vibes.
This card isn’t just Ultra Rare (Rarity Score: 420). It’s a straight-up historical meme artifact celebrating the day Afroman turned a courtroom into comedy gold and proved you can be fried out your mind and STILL defend artistic freedom for every stoner, rapper, and free-speech enjoyer out there.
They tried to silence the artist.
The capybara said “Nah fam… pass the mic.”
17ART — SERIE HONOR EDITION Because I Got High… and still won anyway.
